connectors.name: Airbnb (Privacy Hardening/Deletion)
connectors.description: Checklist for reducing travel and identity exposure on Airbnb.

steps.title: Delete account (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party deletion workflows. Capture proof and schedule a recheck.

steps.title: Enable MFA
steps.instructions: Enable MFA where available and review recovery options. Revoke unknown sessions/devices.

steps.title: Review payment methods
steps.instructions: Remove unused payment methods and review billing history.

steps.title: Minimize profile fields
steps.instructions: Remove non-essential profile information and review public profile visibility.

connectors.name: Amazon (Account Minimization)
connectors.description: Checklist for reducing account takeover risk and minimizing address and payment exposure on Amazon.

steps.title: Close account (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party account closure. Capture proof and schedule a recheck for subscriptions and billing.

steps.title: Enable MFA
steps.instructions: Enable MFA where available and ensure recovery options are current. Prefer app-based methods over SMS when possible.

steps.title: Review payment methods and addresses
steps.instructions: Remove unused payment methods and shipping addresses. Reduce saved data to the minimum you need.

steps.title: Review privacy and ad settings
steps.instructions: Review ad personalization and data sharing settings. Disable what you don't need.

connectors.name: Apple ID (Hardening/Deletion)
connectors.description: Checklist for hardening an Apple ID and reducing linkability across devices and recovery channels.

steps.title: Deactivate/delete (if desired)
steps.instructions: If you plan to leave the ecosystem, use first-party deactivation/deletion options and re-check subscription billing and device sign-in state.

steps.title: Ensure 2FA is enabled
steps.instructions: Confirm Apple ID two-factor authentication is enabled and that trusted devices are limited to what you control.

steps.title: Minimize shared identifiers
steps.instructions: Use Hide My Email where appropriate, review iCloud sharing, and minimize public-facing profile fields.

steps.title: Review trusted numbers and recovery contacts
steps.instructions: Review trusted phone numbers and recovery contacts. Remove anything that is stale or cross-persona linkable.

connectors.name: Discord (Privacy Hardening)
connectors.description: Checklist for reducing account takeover risk and minimizing discoverability on Discord.

steps.title: Delete account (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party account deletion. Capture proof and schedule a recheck for billing and linked integrations.

steps.title: Enable MFA
steps.instructions: Enable MFA and store backup codes securely. Review authorized devices/sessions and revoke unknown ones.

steps.title: Tighten privacy settings
steps.instructions: Review direct message and friend request settings, server privacy defaults, and any data sharing options.

steps.title: Minimize profile identifiers
steps.instructions: Remove links or identifiers that create join keys. Avoid reusing unique usernames across personas.

connectors.name: Dropbox (Privacy Hardening/Deletion)
connectors.description: Checklist for hardening Dropbox and reducing data exposure.

steps.title: Delete account (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party deletion workflows. Capture proof and schedule a recheck.

steps.title: Export and purge data (if leaving)
steps.instructions: Download any needed files, then remove sensitive data and revoke devices/sessions.

steps.title: Enable MFA
steps.instructions: Enable strong MFA and store recovery codes securely. Revoke unknown sessions/devices.

steps.title: Review shared links and connected apps
steps.instructions: Audit shared links and connected apps. Remove what you don't need and expire public links where possible.

connectors.name: Facebook (Account Minimization)
connectors.description: Checklist for hardening or deleting a Facebook account.

steps.title: Delete or deactivate (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party deletion/deactivation workflows. Capture proof and schedule a recheck.

steps.title: Enable phishing-resistant MFA if available
steps.instructions: Prefer passkeys or hardware keys. If not available, enable TOTP and remove SMS recovery where possible.

steps.title: Minimize profile data
steps.instructions: Remove public fields (phone, address, employer, education). Tighten privacy settings and review connected apps.

connectors.name: GitHub (Privacy Hardening)
connectors.description: Checklist for reducing account takeover risk and minimizing public identifiers on GitHub.

steps.title: Delete account (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party deletion workflows. Capture proof and recheck organization access and billing.

steps.title: Minimize public email exposure
steps.instructions: Review public email settings and commit email configuration. Avoid publishing unique identifiers that link personas.

steps.title: Enable strong 2FA
steps.instructions: Prefer passkeys or security keys. If not available, enable TOTP. Store recovery codes securely.

steps.title: Audit tokens and SSH keys
steps.instructions: Review personal access tokens, OAuth apps, SSH keys, and active sessions. Revoke anything unknown or unused.

connectors.name: Google Account (Hardening/Deletion)
connectors.description: Checklist for hardening or deleting a Google account while minimizing recovery and join-key exposure.

steps.title: Delete account (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party deletion workflows. Capture proof, then re-check key services and recovery channels after the processing window.

steps.title: Export data (if deleting)
steps.instructions: If you plan to delete, export your data first (email, drive, photos, etc.). Store the export securely.

steps.title: Enable phishing-resistant MFA
steps.instructions: Prefer passkeys or hardware security keys. If not available, enable TOTP and remove SMS recovery where possible.

steps.title: Review recovery options
steps.instructions: Review recovery email/phone and device prompts. Remove anything you don't control or that links personas. Confirm account recovery settings match your threat model.

connectors.name: Instagram (Privacy Hardening)
connectors.description: Checklist for minimizing discoverability and reducing data sharing on Instagram.

steps.title: Deactivate/delete (if desired)
steps.instructions: Use first-party deactivation/deletion workflows. Capture proof and schedule a recheck.

steps.title: Reduce discoverability
steps.instructions: Review contact sync, phone/email discoverability, and linked accounts. Disable what you don't need.

steps.title: Enable MFA
steps.instructions: Prefer passkeys/hardware keys if supported, otherwise enable TOTP. Reduce SMS recovery where possible.

steps.title: Minimize profile fields
steps.instructions: Remove links, location hints, and identifiers that create join keys. Review tagged photos and mentions.

connectors.name: LinkedIn (Profile Minimization)
connectors.description: Checklist for reducing discoverability and limiting profile exposure on LinkedIn.

steps.title: Minimize profile data
steps.instructions: Remove non-essential employment history, location details, and public contact fields that increase linkability.

steps.title: Harden authentication
steps.instructions: Enable strong MFA. Prefer passkeys/hardware keys if supported; otherwise enable TOTP and remove SMS where possible.

steps.title: Reduce public visibility
steps.instructions: Review public profile settings, search engine visibility, and contact info visibility. Restrict who can see email/phone and connections.

steps.title: Revoke app access

steps.instructions: Use first-party account closure. Capture proof and re-check billing and recovery channels after the processing window.

steps.title: Enable strong MFA
steps.instructions: Enable the strongest available MFA (passkeys, authenticator app, or hardware keys). Reduce reliance on SMS if possible.

steps.title: Review aliases and recovery methods
steps.instructions: Review account aliases, recovery email/phone, and sign-in activity. Remove stale recovery methods and revoke unknown sessions.

connectors.name: Netflix (Privacy Hardening/Deletion)

steps.title: Review billing and payment methods

steps.title: Review devices and sign out

connectors.name: PayPal (Account Hardening/Closure)
